description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.025 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Stock capital allocation quality assessment for any US company. Returns ROIC (Return on Invested Capital), FCF yield, total shareholder yield (dividends + buybacks), CapEx intensity, and reinvestment rate. Synthesizes these into a letter grade (A–F) that answers: is management good at deploying the capital they generate? Designed to chain after equity-fundamentals and wacc-calculator to qualify management quality before setting DCF terminal growth assumptions.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, AMZN). Case-insensitive.

name: capital-allocation-score

capex_reinvestment.description: Capital expenditure intensity and net reinvestment rate.

capex_intensity_pct.description: CapEx as % of revenue. <5% capital-light; >20% capital-heavy.

reinvestment_rate.description: Net Investment / NOPAT. >0 growing asset base; <0 harvesting.

fcf.description: Free cash flow and FCF yield.

grade.description: Capital allocation quality: A (compounder) / B (good) / C (adequate) / D (marginal) / F (value destroyer) / N/A (insufficient data).

grade_score.description: Raw score 0–8 underlying the letter grade.

effective_tax_rate_pct.description: Effective tax rate used in NOPAT calculation (%).

nopat_bn.description: Net Operating Profit After Tax in $B.

roic_pct.description: ROIC % (NOPAT / Invested Capital). >15% excellent, >10% good, >5% adequate, <0% value-destroying.

roic_signal.description: EXCEPTIONAL | EXCELLENT | GOOD | ADEQUATE | BELOW_COC | VALUE_DESTROYING | INSUFFICIENT_DATA

shareholder_yield.description: Cash returned to shareholders via dividends and buybacks.

total_shareholder_yield_pct.description: Total shareholder yield % = Dividend Yield + Buyback Yield.

statement_period.description: Most recent annual statement end date (YYYY-MM-DD).
